$comment: Copy into the ROOT of the WebGL build output (next to index.html) before deploying.
This build uses Gzip compression WITH decompressionFallback enabled, so Unity
emits .unityweb files and the JavaScript loader decompresses them itself.
CRITICAL: do NOT add 'Content-Encoding: gzip' headers for .unityweb files.
That is the correct config for RAW .gz output, and it is actively wrong here —
the browser would decompress the file, then the loader would try to decompress
it a second time and fail. The result is a black page and an opaque error.
Because the fallback does the work in JS, this build runs on ANY static host
with no header configuration at all. Everything below is MIME types and caching,
